params.body:
A sign-up form for the KUBO newsletter, at the bottom of the news overview and of each news post, in English, Dutch and French.

**What it asks**

First name, last name, email and the language of the newsletter (the page's language is ticked). It signs up for the KUBO newsletter, which is a bit more technical than the Afrodidact one; a tick "Also send me the Afrodidact newsletter" adds that one.

**Where it goes**

Afrodidact sends both newsletters and keeps the list, so the form posts to `https://afrodidact.org/api/newsletter-signup` with `site=kubo.global`, `interest=KUBO` and, when ticked, `also=AFRODIDACT`. That site mails a link to confirm; only the click puts someone on the list. Nothing about the visitor is kept on kubo.global. With JavaScript the form sends in the background and says a confirmation mail is on its way; without it, it simply posts. A hidden field catches robots.

This needs kubo-global/afrodidact-website#46 to be live for the tick to count: before that, the Afrodidact site reads the sign-up as KUBO only.

**Checked**

- `npm test` (29) and `npm run build`; `npm run check:built` finds no contact number in the 86 built text files.
- In Chromium against the built site, with the post to afrodidact.org caught: the tick is off at first, the form sends `interest=KUBO` with and without `also=AFRODIDACT`, no sideways scroll on a phone, no script errors.

Not checked in Safari or Firefox.
params.title: Newsletter sign-up for KUBO on the news pages
